name: Christopher Weatherfield
original_name: クリストファー・ウェザーフィールド
source:
Chris hails from England and has an unusual Japanese accent. He loves art and is a member of school's art club. He is actually the heir to a pretty big business run by his father, though he seems a little unprepared for such a role...

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side:_2nd_Kiss#Male_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
